messages.subject: Can I design one item cross several factors in mirt model?
parts:
old_model<-'
f1=q10,q12,q22,q21
f2=q11,q20,q24,q26
f3=q19,q21,q25,q52
f4=q04,q17,q18,q45
'
mirt(df,model=old_model) result shows `q21` loading of `f1` is 0.75,meanwhile,`q21` loading of `f2` is 0.76.
Can I set `q21` in 2 factors as below:

new_model<-'
f1=q10,q12,q22,q21
f2=q11,q20,q24,q26,q21
f3=q19,q21,q25,q52
f4=q04,q17,q18,q45
'
